audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were absent. Riot's Twilight Shroud text says Akali is invisible AND unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks while inside, and that attacking or using abilities briefly reveals her — the page instead claimed her Shroud 'doesn't hide her from your tracking tools'. Second, Shuriken Flip marks the first enemy OR smoke cloud it hits, so the shroud itself is a re-entry anchor.
audit.why: Being unselectable is the reason nothing in Aurora's kit reaches her inside the shroud, and the smoke-cloud mark is how she gets back into it.
audit.corrected: Inside Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1, no mana cost) she cannot be selected by spells or attacks — hold burst for the moment she acts and reveals. Her E marks the smoke cloud, so the flip can take her back in. Also unstated: her passive ring empowers her next auto with bonus range, so the auto wind-up is the burst tell, not the ability cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet reports zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup, and breakdown.cooldowns held no cooldown number. dosFull[2].d also invented a 'fifteen-second' shroud.
audit.why: Defect catalogue item 3, and Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 — fifteen seconds is not a rank of it.
audit.corrected: Twilight Shroud 20s at rank 1, Shuriken Flip 16s at rank 1, Perfect Execution 120s at rank 1 and 60s at rank 3, Across the Veil 22s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Shuriken Tornado' and its 'stun-reset combo' do not exist on Akali — she has no stun anywhere in her kit. 'Shuriton all-in' in mid is the same invention. 'Twin Drift' is not an Aurora ability either.
audit.why: Fabricated ability names, the same class of error as 'Ares of Blaze' for Pyroclasm.
audit.corrected: Her E is Shuriken Flip and her R is Perfect Execution; Aurora's leap is Across the Veil (W). No stun exists in this matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t told the reader to buy anti-heal 'early into his sustain'. Akali's kit as Riot writes it contains no heal.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds bought into a champion with no healing is a wasted item slot.
audit.corrected: Zhonya's is the item that matters here — it answers Perfect Execution.
sources: champ-data/_kits (brief enemyKit: no heal flag or heal text on any slot)

notes:
Level chart: the layers disagreed on six of seven rows — full read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Skill while content read Aurora on all seven. I moved content win[] onto the full layer's sides as one atomic group and rewrote whys[] to match. phases[4] was the worst case in the catalogue's own terms: side said Akali, why described Aurora's zone winning the stage — I rewrote the why to the execute rather than move the side, because a 120s execute at 6 against a 140s zone genuinely favours her. packet.levelChart still reads all-Aurora and now disagrees with both layers; treating it as the stale extract.

Derived-flag misfire: Akali's W carries the flag 'revealsStealth — answers stealth champions'. Riot's own text says the opposite thing — attacking or using abilities briefly reveals HER while she is in the shroud. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about her shroud revealing Aurora's Across the Veil stealth either way; whether Twilight Shroud interacts with Aurora's W invisibility is genuinely unknown from the kit and I did not assert it.

SuspectNames: 'Save Between Worlds' and 'Land Five Point Strike' are both real names, so the near-miss flags are false positives — but both lines were wrong for other reasons (Between Worlds is not the dodge, and Five Point Strike slows rather than marks; the mark is the passive ring).

Sequencing: packet reported 0 sequencing cues. Added concrete ones keyed to Twilight Shroud 20s, Shuriken Flip 16s and Perfect Execution 120s/60s.
